items.exampleEn: Bus fares will rise citywide starting next month.
items.exampleZh: 下個月起，全市的公車票價都會調漲。

items.exampleEn: The kitchen windows face southward, so the room gets sun all day.
items.exampleZh: 廚房的窗戶朝南，所以整天都有陽光照進來。

items.exampleEn: Visitors must speak quietly inside the mausoleum.
items.exampleZh: 遊客在陵墓裡面必須小聲說話。

items.exampleEn: Hundreds of languages are spoken across the Indian subcontinent.
items.exampleZh: 整個印度次大陸上有好幾百種語言。

items.exampleEn: The bathhouse opens at six, and the water is hottest early in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 澡堂六點開門，清晨時水最熱。

items.exampleEn: Kangaroos can travel long distances across the outback to find water.
items.exampleZh: 袋鼠可以在內陸荒野長途跋涉去找水。

items.exampleEn: The homeward journey felt shorter because we sang songs in the car.
items.exampleZh: 回家的路程感覺比較短，因為我們在車上一路唱歌。

items.exampleEn: The new bus card can be used countrywide.
items.exampleZh: 新的公車卡可以在全國使用。

items.sentenceEn: In winter, many birds fly southward to warmer places.
items.sentenceZh: 冬天時，很多鳥會往南飛到比較溫暖的地方。

items.audioEn: There will be a citywide clean-up day on Sunday, so please bring gloves and a bag.
items.audioZh: 星期日有全市清潔日，請帶手套和袋子。

items.sentenceEn: The old bathhouse is now a small museum about the town's history.
items.sentenceZh: 那間老澡堂現在是一座介紹小鎮歷史的小型博物館。

items.sentenceEn: The workers took the homeward train at six, tired but happy.
items.sentenceZh: 工人們六點搭上回家的火車，雖然累但很開心。

items.stemEn: The storm caused power cuts ____, from the north coast to the south.
items.stemZh: 暴風雨在全國各地造成停電，從北部海岸一直到南部。

items.stemEn: The king was buried in a huge stone ____ on the hill.
items.stemZh: 那位國王葬在山丘上一座巨大的石造陵墓裡。

items.passageEn: My uncle is a travel writer, and his new book covers three very different places. The first chapter is about the Australian outback, where he drove for days without seeing another car. Then he traveled to the Indian subcontinent and visited a white marble mausoleum at sunrise. Later, he moved southward to a quiet fishing town, where the public bathhouse is the center of village life. His book became a countrywide best seller, and the city library even held a citywide reading event. Now he is homeward bound, and he says his next masterpiece will be about his own hometown.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔是旅遊作家，他的新書寫了三個截然不同的地方。第一章寫澳洲內陸荒野，他在那裡開了好幾天的車都沒看到別的車。接著他去了印度次大陸，在日出時參觀一座白色大理石陵墓。後來，他往南走到一個寧靜的漁村，那裡的公共澡堂是村民生活的中心。他的書成了全國暢銷書，市立圖書館甚至舉辦了全市讀書活動。現在他正踏上歸途，說他的下一部傑作要寫自己的家鄉。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔在澳洲內陸荒野有什麼經歷？
叔叔說下一本書要寫什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們搭上回家的最後一班火車。
referenceEn: We caught the last train on our homeward journey.
We took the last train homeward.
rubricZh: 要用 homeward（例如 the homeward train、homeward bound）

items.instructionZh: 用 citywide 造一個句子，說說你住的城市舉辦過的全市活動。
referenceEn: My city holds a citywide music festival every summer.
Last year there was a citywide running race, and I joined it with my friends.
